versions.content: Within SoAd_RxIndication() and before analyzing or forwarding of any message data, SoAd shall (a) overwrite the remote address parts specif ied with wildcards (e.g. remote IP address set to TCPIP_IPADDR_ANY) with the related source address part s of the received message and (b) change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE in case all of the following conditions are true: (1) Curre nt connection state is not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE (2) UDP socket (3) SoAdSocketUdpListenOnly is set to FALSE (4) SoAdSocketMsgAcceptanceFilterEnabled is set to TRUE (5) Remote address is set, but contains wildcards (6) Received message is accepted according to the message acceptan ce policy
